# rustinion_log_alert_rule (Resource)

Manages a Rustinion log-based alert rule: fires when at least threshold_count matching log lines land within window_minutes. See log_alerts.rs in the main repo for evaluation semantics; a blank message_pattern/log_severity/log_source is treated as no filter on that field, matching the admin UI's own form.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID of the group this log alert rule belongs to.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `escalation_policy_id` (String) Escalation policy to notify when this rule fires, in the same group. Omit for none.
- `log_severity` (String) Match log lines at this severity or worse: emergency, alert, critical, error, warning, notice, info, debug. Omit for no severity filter.
- `log_source` (String) Restrict matching to one source: journal, kernel, windows_event, macos_unified, syslog, file, container, otlp, datadog, datadog-service-check, datadog-event, panic. Omit for no source filter.
- `message_pattern` (String) Substring/pattern a log line's message must contain to match. Omit for no message filter.
- `severity` (String)
- `threshold_count` (Number) Matching log lines required within window_minutes before the rule fires. Defaults to 1.
- `unit_pattern` (String) Restrict matching to log lines from a service/unit whose name contains this. Omit for no unit filter.
- `window_minutes` (Number) Trailing window, in minutes, threshold_count is evaluated over. Defaults to 5.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned log alert rule ID.
